criteria.description: Escalation candidate enumeration is a single invocation of deterministic tested code, not agent-improvised query construction or inline scripting.
criteria.evidence: WP02 scripts/escalation/enumerate_candidates.py paginates /tasks/all + pure filter_candidates; AGENTS.md Step 2 invokes `python3 -m scripts.escalation.enumerate_candidates` (no vikunja_api-skill/inline-python3). tests/escalation/test_enumerate_candidates.py (40 tests).
criteria.notes: WP02 approved. Live office2 enumeration is post-deploy verification.

criteria.description: Enumeration applies the escalation qualification criteria and returns the qualifying pre-candidate set for the agent.
criteria.evidence: filter_candidates reproduces SKILL.md §1 (done=false, priority>=2, project not excluded, overdue OR due-today+priority>=3), config-sourced exclusions; H8 due-date normalization. Reviewer cross-checked §1 fidelity (no drift).
criteria.notes: Output framed as pre-candidates (H7); derive_state gates final eligibility.

criteria.description: Escalation standing orders call the enumeration code; agent retains only judgment + state recording.
criteria.evidence: WP02 surgical AGENTS.md Step 2 rewrite (single hunk, 12k guard passes); derive_state gate explicit (alert only when next_eligible_level != null); H9 failure propagation (non-zero exit -> failed run).

criteria.description: Weekly habit report is generated and delivered by a scheduled deterministic process with no LLM agent turn.
criteria.evidence: WP03 scripts/habits/weekly_report_driver.py + systemd timer (Mon 06:00 ET); runs query_active_habits_weekly in-process, no LLM. tests/habits/test_weekly_report_driver.py (30 tests).

criteria.description: Delivered weekly-report body is byte-identical to the helper output, prefixed only by a fixed attribution line.
criteria.evidence: compose_message = attribution + '\n\n' + report_body; byte-identical body asserted in tests.

criteria.description: Weekly-report process reports delivery truthfully: success only on confirmed delivery; failures surfaced.
criteria.evidence: confirm_delivery C1 predicate (exit 0 AND non-empty messageId AND dryRun==false); every non-confirmed shape -> delivery_confirmed=false + failure tick + non-zero exit. Adversarially verified across missing/null/malformed/dryRun shapes.
criteria.notes: The core trust invariant; --self-test cannot leak delivered.

criteria.description: Prior LLM-driven weekly-report schedule retired so the report is produced by exactly one path.
criteria.evidence: WP04 deploy entrypoint retires the habits-weekly-report openclaw cron (id-resolve + rm + absence assert) + exactly-one-producer postcheck; service-inventory strips it from habit-checkin. tests/deploy (24 tests).
criteria.notes: Transactional cutover; live cron retirement is post-deploy.

criteria.description: Vikunja scope selectors read from shared config so a taxonomy change is a config edit, not code.
criteria.evidence: WP01 scripts/common/vikunja_scope.py accessors; weekly helper + enumerate_candidates source ids from it (no hardcoded 13). Mutation-tested (flip value -> test breaks). tests/common/test_vikunja_scope.py.
criteria.notes: Value swap is config-only; label FETCH strategy deferred to #716 (post-plan H5).

criteria.description: Both the escalation cron and the new weekly-report process are observable by the health-monitoring system.
criteria.evidence: WP04 service-inventory adds felix-habits-weekly (tick-signal-file, max_age ~8d); escalation-daily stays openclaw-cron-state monitored. Canary registry loader resolves felix-habits-weekly as a covered target (not a gap). validate_architecture_data OK.

criteria.description: Retiring the weekly cron updates the monitored-service definition so the health system monitors the new process instead.
criteria.evidence: WP04 removes habits-weekly-report from habit-checkin crons+schedules+notes (M12); felix-habits-weekly registered. Full suite 4957 pass incl. canary registry tests.
